summary: regex_replace parameters: input, match regex, replacement, count (2.17, 0 = all), ignorecase, mandatory_count (2.17, error unless that many replacements), and multiline.
questions: How do I replace only the first occurrence with regex_replace?
How do I make regex_replace fail if nothing was replaced?
How do I make regex_replace case-insensitive?

answer_card.title: regex_replace parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (required): string to match against
- `_regex_match` (required): pattern
- `_regex_replace` (required): replacement
- `count` (default 0, 2.17+): max replacements; 0 replaces all
- `mandatory_count` (default 0, 2.17+): require exactly this many replacements or raise an error; 0 ignores
- `ignorecase` (default false), `multiline` (default false)
